integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic for complex algebraic C* actions equals that of the fixed locus, and the osculating variety is projective.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A diagonal one-parameter torus with base-B weights B>d separates all degree-d monomials.
integrity.membership_basis: Unique factorization forces a monomial repeated linear divisor to be a coordinate variable.
integrity.object_basis: Archival source supplies O_{k,n,d}={ [L^{d-k}F] } for the osculating-order convention used.
integrity.primary_msc_basis: The projective geometry and osculating-varieties problem is 14N15.
integrity.source_preprint_date_basis: arXiv:math/0403132 records initial submission on 2004-03-08; that date belongs to the cited prior paper, not this finding.

scientific_limitations: Ordinary Euler characteristic only over C; no Betti, Hodge, singularity, degree or higher-secant conclusions.
Stable formula requires strict d>2k; all overlap cases included by full inclusion-exclusion.
No claim of historical priority for known n=1 binary coincident-root strata or k=1 tangential cases.
Full text of Ballico–Fontanari 2003 and Torrance 2026 not read; their accessible descriptions do not by themselves show all-parameter coverage.
Resultary/web no-hit is not proof of originality; residual risks stated.
Independent exact arithmetic covers finite parameter triples only; universal correctness uses mathematical argument.
title: Euler characteristic of every Veronese osculating variety
